snippet.title: Tiny Eden - Available Now!
snippet.description:
Play Tiny Eden on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375110/Tiny_Eden

A cozy first-person farming sim, set in the heart of a futuristic city. Grow plants, cook what you harvest, and discover new varieties as you turn your apartment into a thriving urban garden, from a small balcony to a rooftop paradise.

Join us on Discord → https://discord.gg/tinyedengame
Follow us on X → https://twitter.com/TinyEdenGame
Watch us on TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@tinyedengame
Explore on Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/tinyedengame
